name: @jumentix/cana-vue
description: Vue composables and Pinia-friendly helpers for @jumentix/cana.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @jumentix/cana build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false && bun run build:esm
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target browser --external vue --external pinia --external @jumentix/cana
scripts.lint: echo "cana-vue: covered by the root eslint run"
